summary: Three Fields Entertainment's post-Criterion crash-racing lineage, moving from Burnout Crash-style score attacks in Danger Zone to arcade racing in Dangerous Driving and open-world creation in Wreckreation.

entries.title: Wreckreation

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Wreckreation is the open-world racing/creation follow-up from Three Fields, released for Windows, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S in 2025. Windows is the highest-fidelity configurable route and the most flexible platform for a creation-heavy racer.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS5/Xbox Series X/S as console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Post-launch support should be rechecked because public reporting described studio funding/support trouble after release.
